notes: Level-up cards now look like real trading cards: a rarity frame and gem, a picture window, a name banner, a type line, a text box and level pips. Evolution cards get a gold holo foil, and the reroll cards match.

Heroes have new poses: they face up and down as well as left and right, a dodge pose with afterimages when you jump on the move, a brief moment of invulnerability (a fifth of a second) when you start a jump, and a proper death animation (stagger, fall, fade away).

Enemies now face up and down, flash red as they wind up an attack, and die in three styles: crumble to dust, burst into pieces, or collapse. The number of bodies on screen is capped so phones stay smooth.
Every class has its own talent tree backgrounds, one for each of its three trees, such as a stained-glass chapel for the Knight, blueprints for the Engineer and a clock face for the Chronomancer.
The Armory has a new look: stone walls, wooden weapon racks and flickering torchlight instead of the plain blue, with a scene for each Armory branch.
